reference: Actual frozen GGML public constructors and CPU graphs, captured before new Rust optimizer implementation. No Rust code is imported or executed.
qualifications: Weights/gradients/moments are separate storage, so no cross-input data races or alias effects.
All state snapshots include preserved physical padding; source strides address every operand.
Native executions include one and three workers; element order within a parameter is independent for disjoint rows.
Finite parameter styles include values outside conventional training ranges; source accepts them.
Single exceptional operands are captured, not an assertion of arbitrary multi-NaN payload portability.
